006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * MPTY: Exceptions related to Metapath type errors.
015 */
016public class TypeMetapathException
017    extends MetapathException {
018
019  /**
020   * the serial version UID.
021   */
022  private static final long serialVersionUID = 2L;
023  @NonNull
024  private static final String PREFIX = "MPTY";
025  /**
026   * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#ERRXPTY0004">err:MPTY0004</a>: It
027   * is a <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#dt-type-error">type error</a>
028   * if during the
029   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#dt-static-analysis">static analysis
030   * phase</a>, an expression is found to have a
031   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#dt-static-type">static type</a> that
032   * is not appropriate for the context in which the expression occurs, or during
033   * the <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#dt-dynamic-evaluation">dynamic
034   * evaluation phase</a>, the
035   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#dt-dynamic-type">dynamic type</a> of
036   * a value does not match a required type as specified by the matching rules in
037   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-sequencetype-matching">2.5.5
038   * SequenceType Matching</a>.
039   */
040  // FIXME: differentiate static vs dynamic errors
041  public static final int INVALID_TYPE_ERROR = 4;
042  /**
043   * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#ERRXPTY0019">err:MPTY0019</a>: It
044   * is a <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#dt-type-error">type error</a>
045   * if {@code E1} in a path expression {@code E1/E2} does not evaluate to a
046   * sequence of nodes.
047   */
048  public static final int BASE_PATH_NOT_A_SEQUENCE = 19;
049  /**
050   * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#ERRXPTY0020">err:MPTY0020</a>: The
051   * context item is not a node when evaluating an axis step.
052   */
053  public static final int NOT_A_NODE_ITEM_FOR_STEP = 20;
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
057   * and {@code cause}.
058   *
059   * @param code
060   *          the error code value
061   * @param message
062   *          the exception message
063   * @param cause
064   *          the original exception cause
065   */
066  protected TypeMetapathException(
067      int code,
068      @Nullable String message,
069      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
070    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
075   * and no cause.
076   *
077   * @param code
078   *          the error code value
079   * @param message
080   *          the exception message
081   */
082  public TypeMetapathException(
083      int code,
084      @Nullable String message) {
085    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
086  }
087}
